text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"May 31st: It was a totally marvelous 
birthday!" And... done!☆★

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oho... So that's the rumored 'Diary That 
Turns Whatever You Write Into Reality'?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's right! With this, today is 
guaranteed to be a MARVELOUS birthday☆★

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufufufu, what a wonderful diary. ...But 
is that really all you wrote down?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Why don't you try opening that diary one 
more time?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—Ah!? There's more writing added!? "A 
marvelous cake was delivered to my room." 
...This is Fuji's handwriting, isn't it!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, go check for yourself! It should 
really have come true, you know.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Let's make this marvelous even 
MORE marvelous—☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Hey, Fuji! This will come true too, right?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha! Of course! There's no way such 
a Marvelous future won't come true!
